title: Lemma Pro Health Score v1
description: Overall health score (0-100) computed deterministically from a lemma report. Formula (v1): let checks be report.checks (or derived from findings/coverage), base=100, subtract 25 per critical finding, 15 per high, 8 per medium, 3 per low, 1 per info (using finding severity); subtract 10 per failed/blocked/errored check not already represented, subtract 5 per skipped check as coverage gap pressure (capped contribution); add 0 (no positive inflation from gaps). Clamp to [0,100], round to nearest integer. Breakdowns: per dimension (domain), per check family (check id prefix/family), per persona (owner/persona). Changing this formula requires a new schema version.
